headline: BI and OJK Agree to Regulate Out-of-Court Dispute Settlement Institutions
summary: Bank Indonesia and OJK signed joint implementing guidelines to operationalise an alternative dispute resolution body for the financial sector outside the courts.
why: Bank Indonesia is the central bank and OJK is the financial services regulator, and their joint rules shape consumer recourse in financial services.
original_headline: BI dan OJK Sepakat Atur Lembaga Penyelesaian Sengketa di Luar Pengadilan
